context_notes: Wave execution pattern is well-established: (1) base-check guard, (2) capture EXPECTED_BASE, (3) spawn gsd-executor Agent with isolation=worktree model=opus run_in_background=false, (4) after agent returns: rm -rf worktree/.claude (harness copies it and it blocks cleanup), git merge agent-branch, git worktree remove, git branch -D, git worktree prune, (5) pnpm --if-present --recursive test:quick to catch regressions, (6) fix any post-merge test failures and commit as fix(XX-XX), (7) next wave. Common post-merge issues: executors missing await on async render(), using destructured render() without await, using view.getByText (DOM testing library API) instead of view.getByText (RNTL API after await), duplicate text in components causing getByText to throw 'Found multiple elements'. Integration tests can't run due to Docker PostgreSQL 18 healthcheck — only quick (unit) tests gate each wave.
